events.title: Beers + Maintenance | Trailside Tune Up
events.description: Trailside Tune Up with Daily Cycle AVL. Hands-on clinic for all skill levels covering skipping shifting, chain issues, rubbing brakes, and valve core problems. Cost is $30. Rain or shine event. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: Test + Tune with Cane Creek Components (Again)
events.description: Suspension test + tune with Cane Creek Components. For all people with bikes with suspension comfortable riding downhill on trails with rocks and roots. Meet at Explorer Loop parking lot. No e-bikes allowed. Register by email to Dorene O'Malley. First 8 emails get a spot. For all women 18 or older.

events.title: November Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Pisgah and DuPont. Post-ride social at Oskar Blues Brewery, 342 Mountain Industrial Dr, Brevard, NC 28712. Neither location allows e-bikes. For all women 18 and older.

events.title: Volunteer Appreciation Party
events.description: Celebration for volunteers from the past year. Includes prizes, giveaways, food, and one drink provided. Partners are allowed. No bikes needed.

events.title: December Group Ride + Social
events.description: Riding in Hot Springs. Post-ride social at Big Pillow Brewing, 25-27 N Andrews Avenue, Hot Springs, NC 28743-9231. This location does not allow e-bikes. For all women 18 and older.
